column3: "Warning! Pressure is dropping because an oxygen storage tank is leaking!"
column7: "Switch to a backup oxygen tank right away!"
column8: "Just wait and hope it stops leaking."

column3: "The Four Bed Molecular Sieve (CO2 removal) broke down. The crew has headaches from bad air!"
column7: "Use lithium hydroxide (LiOH) canisters to absorb the gas."
column8: "Ignore it and keep working with no filters."

column3: "The multifiltration water processor failed. Total reliance on recycling is threatened!"
column7: "Draw emergency drinking water from the survival storage reserve."
column8: "Force the Vapor Compression Distillation (VCD) unit to run past its limits."

column3: "The crew needs more oxygen pumped into the cabin from the high-pressure storage tanks."
column8: "Keep the valves half-closed to save tank safety."

column3: "The Solid Polymer Water Electrolysis machine that splits water to make fresh oxygen is overheating."
column7: "Send extra electrical power to cool down the electrolysis unit!"
column8: "Slow down the oxygen production to save electricity."

column3: "The Sabatier carbon dioxide reduction reactor broke down! If we don't fix it, we will lose the oxygen tied up in exhaled gases."
column7: "Vent the carbon dioxide into space and rely purely on our limited stored oxygen tanks."
column8: "Force the broken reactor to keep running to recycle every drop of oxygen."

column3: We have an empty growing tray. Should we plant lettuce for an earlier harvest or soybeans for a larger harvest later?
"The space station battery is charging up toward its 15 kWh limit, but the power lines are getting hot!"
column7: "Divert excess power into life-support and oxygen generators (OGS) to relieve the battery lines."
column8: "Throttle down the solar arrays immediately to cool the power lines and protect the grid."

column3: "A massive Martian dust storm is coming to our base. The sust in the atmosphere is already reducing the amount of sunlight reaching the solar panels."
column7: "Charge the batteries while there is still sunlight, and postpone experiments that consume a lot of energy."
column8: "Continue with all experiments and activities as usual."

column3: "Because we didn't clean the dust off, the solar panels are choking!"
column7: "Shut down non-vital habitat systems to save what is left of our 15 kWh power pool."
column8: "Keep all systems running and burn through our emergency battery reserves."

column3: "Mission control warns of an incoming solar flare! Radiation levels are spiking outside our standard radiation shielding."
column7: "Order the crew into the heavily shielded central storm shelter immediately!"
column8: "Ignore the warning and keep working outside to maintain food crop modules."

column3: "The Vapor Compression Distillation (VCD) machine that recycles urine and wastewater is clogged with heavy deposits!"
column7: "Run a low-power bypass cleaning mode that saves electricity but consumes extra water."
column8: "Ignore the clogging and keep running the dirty machine."

column3: "Because we didn't clean the VCD processor, the recycling system completely broke down! Wastewater is piling up"
column7: "Open emergency stored water reserves to keep the base hydrated."
column8: "Force the broken machine to run without repairs, risking total water loss."

column3: "High-energy galactic cosmic rays (GCRs) reflecting off the Martian surface are hitting the ship, threatening the radiation shield!"
column7: "Keep the radiation shield at baseline to conserve battery power."
column8: "Overcharge the active electromagnetic shield to deflect the SEP surge."
